findings: Four internal candidates failed the paired positive/blocking source-condition test gate. The final candidate is unsigned and was not applied.

The candidate accepts forecasted_hindrance_calendar_month_count as a precomputed Decimal and compares it with6. It does not derive the calendar interval from dated forecast evidence as requested. A decimal month convention is unspecified.

Bare body_or_health_condition_deviates_from_age_typical_condition and impairment_interacts_with_barriers_to_hinder_equal_participation inputs reproduce constituent legal standards without a documented observable-record derivation or explanation of independently existing medical observations. The requested leaf boundary was not established.

The sixteen-input scalar model contains no actual assessment, subject, observation, issuance or prognosis date associations. Its Boolean forecast labels cannot by themselves prove which person or period a real finding describes.
The permanent-hindrance branch avoids a finite end date, but this does not cure the broader evidence and duration-boundary defects.

Fixing only the missing companion pairs would not make this candidate acceptable. A repair needs an observable evidence model and exact temporal rules, or an explicit unresolved qualitative-definition dependency; no renamed legal-status inputs.
disposition: No module or manifest declared. No spine or legal dependency closed. Do not replay unchanged or weaken tests; native standard budget remains in force.

paired_witness_diagnostic.finding: The unchanged validator recognizes eight one-input toggled witnesses, including the age-deviation and threatened-disability pairs, but assigns no witness to either German source clause.
